sentences.en: I happened to find a bicycle discarded at the roadside.
sentences.zh: 我碰巧在路边发现了一辆被丢弃的自行车。

sentences.en: A lot of the discarded items are of amazing quality.
sentences.zh: 很多被遗弃的物品质量出奇的好。

sentences.en: Experience, when it is dearly bought, is never discarded.
sentences.zh: 亲身经历一旦付出了高昂代价就永远不会被抛弃。

senses.zh: 抛弃；被丢弃的东西或人
